name: Kokiri Tunic
where: You wear it from the start.
effect: Child Link's green outfit; as an adult it is called the Hero's Clothes.

name: Hero's Clothes
where: Adult Link's green outfit, from the moment you draw the Master Sword.
effect: No special effect: the adult Kokiri Tunic under the remake's new name.

name: Goron Tunic
where: Darunia's son gives it to you when you stop him in Goron City (adult), or buy it at the Goron Shop for 600 Rupees (per Zelda Wiki).
effect: Protects you from heat. The remake has no timer: without it you lose health very fast in Death Mountain Crater and the Fire Temple.

name: Zora Tunic
where: King Zora gives it to you when you thaw him with Blue Fire (adult); the Zora Domain shop also sells it (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: You breathe underwater without limit.

name: Kokiri Boots
where: You wear them from the start.
effect: Normal footwear: switch back to them with D-pad ↓.

name: Iron Boots
where: The Ice Cavern, after beating the White Wolfos.
effect: They sink you underwater and hold you against wind. In the remake they go on and off instantly with D-pad ↓.

name: Hover Boots
where: The Shadow Temple, after beating Dead Hand.
effect: You float for a moment over gaps and quicksand, but you slide: they have no grip.

name: Goron Bracelet
where: Darunia in Goron City, when you play him Saria's Song (child).
effect: Lets you pick up Bomb Flowers.

name: Silver Gauntlets
where: The Spirit Temple, at the end of the child side, on one of the colossus's hands; adult Link uses them.
effect: Lets you lift big stone blocks.

name: Golden Gauntlets
where: Ganondorf's Castle, in the Shadow trial.
effect: Lets you lift the heaviest blocks (needed for the Light trial).

name: Silver Scale
where: The diving game in Zora Domain (child).
effect: You dive deeper. You need it to reach Lord Jabu-Jabu.

name: Golden Scale
where: The Lake Hylia fishing pond, by landing a record fish as an adult (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: You dive even deeper.

name: Lenses of Truth
where: The Bottom of the Well, after beating Dead Hand.
effect: Goggles worn as headgear (D-pad ↑): they show false walls, hidden floors and invisible enemies inside a purple eye. They drain magic while worn.
verdict: Required for the Shadow Temple and against Bongo Bongo.

name: Kokiri Wallet
where: You have it from the start.
effect: Holds up to 200 Rupees (wallets hold twice as much in the remake).

name: Adult's Wallet
where: The House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village: 10 Gold Skulltula tokens.
effect: Holds up to 500 Rupees.

name: Giant's Wallet
where: The House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village: 30 Gold Skulltula tokens.
effect: Holds up to 1,000 Rupees.

name: Quiver
where: Comes with the Fairy Bow; the bigger ones come from the Kakariko Village shooting gallery and the Gerudo's Fortress horseback archery (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: How many arrows you carry: Quiver, Bigger Quiver and Biggest Quiver. The remake's numbers are not known yet.

name: Bomb Bag
where: The first one in Dodongo's Cavern; the bigger ones at the Castle Town Bombchu Bowling Alley and in Goron City (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: Lets you carry bombs: Bomb Bag, Bigger and Biggest. The remake's numbers are not known yet.

name: Deku-Seed Bag
where: Comes with the Fairy Slingshot; the bigger ones from the Castle Town shooting gallery and the Lost Woods (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: How many Deku Seeds you carry (three sizes).

name: Deku-Stick Bag
where: New in the remake, in three sizes; where the upgrades come from is not yet confirmed (in the base game a Deku Scrub and the Lost Woods stage gave them).
effect: How many Deku Sticks you carry.

name: Deku-Nut Bag
where: New in the remake, in three sizes; where the upgrades come from is not yet confirmed (in the base game a Deku Scrub and the Lost Woods stage gave them).
effect: How many Deku Nuts you carry.

name: Magic Meter
where: A Great Fairy (in the base game, the one at the summit of Death Mountain; the remake moved two fountains, so check which one gives it) (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: Unlocks magic: the Lenses of Truth, magic arrows, Din's Fire, Farore's Wind and Nayru's Love.
verdict: Essential: get it as soon as you can.

name: Gift of Doubled Magic
where: The Great Fairy in Death Mountain Crater, as an adult (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: Doubles your magic meter.

name: Gift of Halved Damage
where: The Great Fairy hidden by Ganondorf's Castle, behind a block you lift with the Golden Gauntlets (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: You take half damage.

name: Gift of Improved Spin
where: Per Zelda Wiki, the Great Fairy by Hyrule Castle (in the original she was on Death Mountain) (not yet confirmed for the remake).
effect: A stronger spin attack; in the remake it no longer uses magic.
